supporting_observations.claim: At 13:42:39 UTC, WS-MLOPEZ-01 accepted a network logon for omar.haddad from WS-OHADDAD-01, and the session received special privileges. This is consistent with the inventory's stated remote-administration source.

At 13:44:39 UTC, PowerShell ran as omar.haddad with the command line specifying the inventory-listed \\FILE-HD-01\IT\Deploy-Patches.ps1 script. This aligns with the reported brief PowerShell appearance and the documented patching procedure.

The PowerShell process launched wusa to install a Windows 11 KB update, and the proxy recorded a Windows Update download during the same activity. These records support a patching explanation for the PowerShell execution.
The recorded PowerShell process ended at 13:45:06 UTC.

known_telemetry_limitations: Process creation records show PowerShell execution but do not establish whether a visible window appeared on Maria's screen.
The records show the patch script's path and subsequent update installation, but not the script contents, its integrity, or its full execution output.
The PowerShell process is recorded at 13:44:39 UTC; the evidence does not show a PowerShell process at exactly 13:40 UTC.
claims_not_established: Whether Maria directly saw this PowerShell process or a different window.
Whether the patch script's contents were unmodified and fully authorized.
Whether this benign explanation accounts for every detail of the reported window.
unrelated_findings: GlobalProtect PanGPS.exe ran on WS-MLOPEZ-01, although the inventory says the organization has no VPN. Review separately; this does not determine the disposition of the alerted PowerShell activity. (T024-00039, T024-00040)
Google Drive File Stream launched under maria.lopez; the inventory lists OneDrive but no other approved cloud-storage services. Review separately. (T024-00278, T024-00280)

WS-MLOPEZ-01 made an explicit-credential logon attempt using svc-bkp to PROXY-HD-01. The inventory describes svc-bkp as a backup agent on FILE-HD-01, so this workstation activity merits separate review. (T024-00043)
